lines.l: In a t-shirt and tight-fitting jeans

And I said to myself
What a nice way it'd be to spend the night
Just as someone asked me to dance

And our eyes held each other
Though the arms of another held me tight
There was magic in the way he looked at me
What was going through his mind was plain to see
I was wishing he would show me
When the music stopped, my wish came true
He said, you don't know me
And I don't know you
But I know what you're feeling
Cause I'm feeling this too
This can't be wrong, it feels so right
It's alright
Love at first time
I was shocked to say the least as he talked
I was weak in the knees as we walked

I said you don't know me, and I don't know you
But I know what you're feeling, cause I'm feeling it too
This can't be wrong, it feels so right
Love at first sight
I know me, I don't know you
But I know what you're feeling, cause I'm feeling it too

No way
